title: Graphical Verification of Approximation Error for Second-Order System Time Specifications
expert_review: This problem effectively connects theoretical approximations with practical validation methods. It reinforces the importance of understanding error bounds in engineering approximations and provides a clear example of graphical analysis.
source: Adapted from control systems textbook (e.g., Equation 6.11)
learning_objectives: Interpret standard approximate formulas for rise time and settling time.
Define and calculate relative error for an engineering approximation.
Describe the process for graphically verifying an error bound over a parameter range.
Extract quantitative conclusions (max error < 1%) from provided graphical data.
Appreciate the practical utility and limitations of common control system design approximations.
